reason: An ecosystem trend dashboard that snapshots public GitHub plugin data, stores local history, computes trend reports and keyword alerts, and presents results in a read-only panel.

summaries.zh: 用于采集公开 GitHub 插件数据并保存本地历史，生成生态趋势报告、关键词雷达和可视化仪表盘。
summaries.en: A dashboard that snapshots public GitHub plugin data, maintains local history, generates ecosystem trend reports and keyword alerts, and visualizes the results.

capabilities: Reads public GitHub topic and repository data
Writes append-only snapshot and watch data to a local directory
Computes trend reports, rankings, category heat, and keyword watch results
Displays read-only trend data in an experimental web panel
